special.note: kiosk placement-bonus spaces (kiosk icon); when all covered, +1 money income per kiosk at each break

uncertain: left-edge 4th purple token (replaces conservation 1): a half-dark half-light animal silhouette (llama/camel-like) with number 2; meaning unknown, not in Map 0
col 3 row 3: icon is an X-token on top plus an '@'-like/dark-bar glyph (sponsor_for_money) - unknown bonus, not seen on Map 0
bonus naming: card icon = white card with cube and mortarboard (same as Map 0 'card'); clever icon at col7 row3 matches Map 0 col5 row3
notes: Grid shape matches Map 0 (6/7/6/7/6/7/6/7/6). Differences vs Map0 side panels: partner slot 4 has NO bonus (Map0: conservation 2); university slot 3 gives conservation 1 (Map0: 2); left edge 4th purple token is the unknown animal-silhouette-2 (Map0: conservation 1). Last worker, upgrade/worker slots, yellow tokens identical to Map0. Red worker-II tab at left of pink/blue border present as on Map0. Three kiosk icons on the board (hex-with-kiosk pictogram). Note card/mortarboard icon is language-independent.

identified.sponsor_for_money: coin marked X beside a blue '@' card: play a sponsor card from hand by paying its level (official FAQ: from hand only, not the display)
identified.university: grey pillared building: gain a university
identified.multiplier: x2: multiplier token on an action card (as the bonus tile)
identified.upgrade_PROBABLE: card with a circular arrow, red/blue stripe: read as upgrade an action card; not confirmed by a written source
identified.animal_silhouette_2_UNKNOWN: map 7 purple token: half-dark animal silhouette with 2; meaning unknown
